title: Reading Centre from Standard Form
text:
In the standard form $$(x-a)^2 + (y-b)^2 = r^2$$:
- Centre is at (a, b)
- Radius is r

From $$(x-3)^2 + (y+2)^2 = 25$$:
- a = 3
- Note: (y+2) = (y-(-2)), so b = -2

title: Calculate Radius
text:
Since $$r^2 = 25$$, what is the radius r?

$$r = \sqrt{25} = ?$$
